questions.prompt: What is one main reason Grade 5 learners study Religious Education?

questions.correctAnswer: To learn values for responsible living
questions.explanation: Religious Education helps learners understand beliefs, values, and respectful choices in daily life.

questions.prompt: Which value is shown when a learner listens politely to a classmate from another faith?
